channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Dark Horse: sem dinheiro público e com o Havengate como o maior investidor, diz perícia
item.description: A forensic audit completed in June ruled out the use of public funds for Dark Horse's financing, concluding the film was fully funded by private investments led by the Texas fund Havengate with an injection of $13.3 million from R$61 million allocated by Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Clariana Barão, do DC, defende reforma no STF e fim da 6 X 1
item.description: Clariana Barão, DC presidential candidate and state directory president in MT, supports reforming the STF, reviewing January 8th cases, ending the 6X1 work schedule, and maintains right-wing stances including defense of life and criticism of extremism. In an interview with Poder360, she praised Lula's government for social transfer programs and highlighted Flávio Bolsonaro as a key figure from the right.

item.title: Mendonça propõe que TSE discuta tese que flexibiliza uso de deepfake nas eleições
item.description: Minister André Mendonça proposed that the TSE discuss a thesis to relax the court's ban on deepfakes in elections, considering them only when capable of deceiving voters. He distinguishes deepfakes from memes, caricatures, and other evidently fictional representations produced with AI.

item.title: Vettorazzo dá voz de prisão por oferta de propina em licitação
item.description: Amanda Vettorazzo, city councilwoman in São Paulo and campaign coordinator for presidential candidate Renan Santos, placed a man named Fernando under arrest on active corruption charges, alleging he offered a bribe in exchange for favoring Oakmont Group in a bid for body cameras for the Metropolitan Guard. Vettorazzo claims she recorded the meeting and refused the offer, while the company denies having an employee by that name and vows to investigate.

item.title: Lula tem 54% e Flávio 20% em 1º turno no RN, diz Quaest
item.description: Quaest survey for Grupo Globo shows Lula leading with 54% in the first round in RN, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 20%. The survey, registered with TSE, interviewed 804 voters between August 20-23, with a 3-point margin of error.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral valida documentação da candidatura de Caiado após verificar falhas
item.description: Brazil's Electoral Court validated today the documentation of Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) candidacy for the presidency, after the TSE (Superior Electoral Court) had given a two-day deadline for the Electoral Public Ministry to reassess the documents that contained flaws.

item.title: Cineasta e organização lançam 'Carta Anticensura' e cobram compromisso de candidatos com liberdade de expressão
item.description: Filmmaker Newton Cannito and the Free Speech Union Brazil organization launched an "Anti-Censorship Letter" requesting that candidates in the elections commit to freedom of expression.

item.title: Mendonça propõe critério para definir deepfake eleitoral
item.description: Minister André Mendonça, vice-president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), proposes an objective criterion to identify electoral deepfakes in the 2026 elections. The initiative establishes that the sole use of artificial intelligence is not sufficient to characterize a deepfake, requiring additional elements that mislead voters. The decision will be submitted to the court's plenary.

item.title: Lira encontra Flávio Bolsonaro em culto após evitar agendas em Alagoas
item.description: Arthur Lira and Flávio Bolsonaro were spotted at a religious ceremony of the Assembleia de Deus in Maceió, but no formal political meeting took place. The encounter fuels speculation about alliances ahead of the 2026 elections, as Lira avoided joining Flávio's public agenda.

item.title: Flávio diz que R$ 600 do Bolsa Família já "não enchem mais o carrinho"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated in Maceió that the R$600 Bolsa Família benefit has lost purchasing power over the past four years, pledging to maintain it alongside broader public policies. On his first campaign trip outside the Southeast, he proposed infrastructure, railway, and agricultural development projects for the Northeast.

item.title: Coordenadora da campanha de Renan Santos grava suposta oferta de propina
item.description: Councilwoman Amanda Vettorazzo (União Brasil), coordinator of Renan Santos' campaign, reported an alleged bribe attempt of R$200k plus future commission to favor a company in a body camera contract for the Metropolitan Civil Guard. The suspect was detained in her office and the case is under investigation for active corruption.

item.title: Furlan lidera com 55% nas intenções de voto no Amapá, diz pesquisa Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on August 25, 2026 shows that Dr. Furlan (PSD) leads the gubernatorial race in Amapá with 55% of voter intention, followed by Clécio Luís (União Brasil) with 35%. The margin of error is three percentage points, with 804 respondents surveyed between August 21 and 24.

item.title: Mendonça manda retirar deepfake que liga Flávio a Vorcaro e rachadinha
item.description: TSE Justice André Mendonça ordered the removal of a deepfake video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro and an alleged 'rachadinha' scheme. The AI-generated content features realistic simulations of the presidential candidate and uses a parody of the song 'P do Pecado' to insinuate illicit enrichment. Mendonça also requested that Meta provide data to identify the individual behind the @forabolsonaronational account.

item.title: Quaest no AP: 37% desaprovam e 53% aprovam o governo Clécio Luís
item.description: A Quaest survey released August 25 shows 53% of respondents approve of Clécio Luís' government (União Brasil), while 37% disapprove. Despite approval, 54% of voters believe he should not be re-elected or should elect a successor. The main problem in the state is health, cited by 43% of respondents.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 41% no 1º turno no Paraná, diz Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll in Paraná shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 41% of voting intentions in the first round, followed by Lula (PT) with 23%. The survey tested two scenarios, with and without Pablo Marçal, and Flávio leads in both. Lula's government approval stands at 36%, while 60% disapprove.

item.title: Sem explicações sobre ‘Dark Horse’, Mário Frias reaparece pedindo votos para Flávio
item.description: Mário Frias reappeared on social media campaigning for Flávio Bolsonaro without addressing the PF investigation into the film 'Dark Horse'. The former government official had promised details about the production but left Brazil without providing explanations.

item.title: Lula tem 54% e Flávio, 19% no 1º turno em PE, diz pesquisa
item.description: Quaest poll in Pernambuco shows Lula (PT) leading with 54% of voting intentions in the 2026 presidential first round, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 19%. With Pablo Marçal (PRTB) included, Lula reaches 55%. For Senate, Marília Arraes (PDT) leads at 16%, followed by Humberto Costa (PT) at 13%.

item.title: Flávio e Lula empatam no 1º turno no RJ, diz pesquisa
item.description: Quaest poll commissioned by Grupo Globo shows a tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) in the first-round presidential race in Rio de Janeiro. Flávio leads with 31% against Lula's 29% in Scenario 1, based on a survey of 1,302 voters from August 21–24, with a 3-point margin of error and 95% confidence, filed with TSE under RJ-08748/2026.

item.title: Quaest no TO: Lula, 37%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 32%; Ronaldo Caiado, 7%; Renan Santos; 3%
item.description: Quaest poll in Tocantins shows Lula leading with 37% (without Marçal) and 39% (with Marçal), followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 32% in both scenarios. Ronaldo Caiado has 7%, while Pablo Marçal appears with 4% when included. Lula's government approval stands at 49% vs 44% disapproval.

item.title: Mendonça propõe ao TSE tese para definir o que é deepfake nas eleições
item.description: Minister André Mendonça proposed to the TSE a thesis defining deepfakes for the 2026 elections. The standard requires AI-generated content to have realism capable of creating false perception of authenticity, distinguishing prohibited deepfakes from labeled memes and caricatures.

item.title: Nenhum festival de música leva política tão a sério quanto a Festa do Peão de Barretos
item.description: The 71st Barretos Rodeo Festival moved approximately 600 million reais in the economy and attracted 900,000 visitors, yet stood out for its political overtones. Ambassador Ana Castela posed with federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira, drawing criticism from Luana Piovani and Pabllo Vittar, while Gusttavo Lima avoided politics but the crowd booed President Lula. Right-wing figures like São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attended, cementing Barretos as a political stage.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado e a falta de bons modos na campanha eleitoral
item.description: The article criticizes the vulgarity and lack of manners displayed by presidential candidates in Sunday's debate, highlighting Renan Santos's (Missão) aggressiveness toward Janja da Silva and Erika Hilton, in contrast to Ronaldo Caiado's more civil demeanor. Using references to Plutarch, Cicero, Hannah Arendt, and the McCarthy-Welch exchange, the piece laments the decline of rhetoric and civility in the current campaign.

item.title: TCU vê governo fazer anúncio de políticas energéticas não instituídas
item.description: The TCU found that the federal government announces energy and mining policies that are not implemented, such as the National Mining Plan 2050 and the ENEP, creating systemic risk. Minister Walton Alencar Rodrigues highlighted delays and unheld meetings, classifying the issue as a priority for oversight, with unanimous support from the Court of Accounts.

item.title: Tarcísio condiciona ritmo de obras em SP a cenário nacional: 'Depende do rumo do País'
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas stated that the pace of infrastructure works in São Paulo depends on the national fiscal scenario. The governor emphasized that the state's agenda advancement will be conditioned on the country's economic outlook.

item.title: Renan Santos anuncia Amanda Vettorazzo como ministra da secretaria-geral, caso vença eleições
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate, announced Amanda Vettorazzo as Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency if he wins the 2026 elections. The city councilor and campaign coordinator is the first name appointed to a ministry by the candidate. The announcement was made during a press conference.

item.title: Governo Lula usa pessoas como “massa de manobra”, diz Clariana Barão
item.description: Clariana Barão (DC) accuses Lula's government of using public advertising for electoral purposes and cites the National Pact Against Femicide as a publicity stunt without real results. The federal government counters with data showing a 3.2% reduction in femicides from January to July.

item.title: Eduardo posta vídeo antigo de multidão recebendo Bolsonaro e diz ser de agenda de Flávio no Nordeste
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro shared on X a video from August 2024 showing crowds welcoming Jair Bolsonaro in Gravatá (PE), claiming it was from Flávio Bolsonaro's agenda in Maceió. The original video was posted by Jair Bolsonaro himself on Instagram, and details such as car arrangement, shirts, and flags confirm it is the same event.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio prevê derrota em julgamento sobre deep fake no TSE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign concedes it will likely lose the TSE case regarding deep fake use in electoral advertising. The expectation is that the court will ban pieces employing this technology. The news was released on 08/25/2026.

item.title: Quaest no Amapá: Lula, 36%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 32%
item.description: Quaest poll released by Rede Amazônica shows a tight race in Amapá: Lula (PT) leads with 36% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has 32% in the scenario with Pablo Marçal, and 33% without him. The survey also shows 47% disapproval and 46% approval of Lula's government, with 74% of voters saying their candidate choice is definitive.

item.title: Mercadante rebate Zema, que prometeu privatizar o BNDES e a Petrobras
item.description: Aloizio Mercadante rejected Romeu Zema's proposal to privatize BNDES and Petrobras, calling it an outdated idea. He defended the partnership between state and market, highlighting BNDES's role in long-term projects such as the recovery of Rio Grande do Sul and the energy transition. Regarding Petrobras, he emphasized its profitability and importance for pre-salt exploration.

item.title: Flávio tem 31% ante 30% de Lula no 1º turno em MG, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey released on August 25, 2026 shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the first round of the presidential election in Minas Gerais. Both lead with 31% and 30% of voting intention, respectively, followed by Zema (Novo) with 7%. The survey also indicates that Marília Campos (PT) leads the Senate race in MG.

item.title: Flávio vai à Convenção dos Ministros das Assembleias de Deus
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, will attend the Convention of the Pentecostal Ministers in Maceió (AL) on Tuesday (25) at 7:30 PM, celebrating the 111th anniversary of the denomination in the state. The event is part of the candidate's schedule in Alagoas, the home state of his running mate, Alfredo Gaspar (PL).

item.title: Quaest: Lucas Ribeiro possui 38% na Paraíba; Cícero Lucena tem 19%
item.description: Quaest poll in São Paulo (SP) has not been released; however, the Paraíba survey indicates Governor Lucas Ribeiro (PP) leads with 38% against Cícero Lucena (MDB) at 19%. The margin of error is 3 points.

item.title: Tralli e Renata entrevistam Caiado, candidato a presidente pelo PSD
item.description: The Progresso group features interviews by César Tralli and Renata Vasconcellos with the six presidential candidates scheduled from August 24 to 29, broadcast live and made fully available afterward.

item.title: Encarceramento, voto de presos e perda de bens são debatidos em audiência no STF
item.description: During a public hearing at the STF, experts discussed the Anti-Faction Law, highlighting the prohibition of voting by pretrial detainees and its impacts on due process. Critics argue the measure violates constitutional rights, while others support the criminalization of organized crime-related offenses.

item.title: Visita ao Poder360: Clariana Barão
item.description: Clariana Barão, a presidential candidate and head of the Christian Democracy directory in Mato Grosso, visited the Poder360 headquarters in Brasília, where she gave a live interview discussing the 2026 elections and her proposals for a potential administration. During the conversation, she addressed key themes of her government plan, emphasizing her stances on the economy, security, health, education, and anti-corruption efforts, as well as aspects related to foreign policy and pension reform.

item.title: Quaest em Rondônia: Flávio Bolsonaro, 45%; Lula, 25%
item.description: Quaest poll for Rede Amazônica in Rondônia shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 45% against Lula's 25% in the first-round presidential race. Among 79% of respondents, the choice is definitive, while the Lula government has only 35% approval with 56% disapproval. Pablo Marçal, despite ineligibility, appears in the survey and his case will be judged by the TSE.

item.title: Lula e Flávio empatam em 1º turno no DF, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Quaest survey released on August 25, 2026, shows a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the first-round presidential race in the Federal District, with 28% and 26% respectively in the simulation without Pablo Marçal. The survey interviewed 1,104 voters between August 21 and 24, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE julga reserva de vagas para mulheres em partidos
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) discusses in a plenary session on Tuesday (August 25, 2026) a consultation by Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) regarding measures to increase women's participation in the structure of political parties, including the possibility of reserving seats for women in party executives and the allocation of resources to programs encouraging female political participation.

item.title: "Projeto que mais me orgulho", diz Tarcísio sobre privatização da Sabesp
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas highlighted Sabesp's privatization as the most transformative project of his administration, arguing it prevented a sector crisis and expanded water and sanitation services to millions. He emphasized its role in mitigating the state's water crisis and unlocking potentials like the Billings reservoir. The statement was made at the 2026 Elections Forum, attended by presidential and São Paulo gubernatorial candidates.

item.title: Quaest no AP: Dr Furlan, 55%; Clécio Luís, 35%
item.description: The Quaest poll, commissioned by Rede Amazônica, shows Dr Furlan (PSD) leading with 55% in the prompted poll and 43% in the spontaneous poll, compared to 35% and 22% for Clécio Luís (União Brasil). The choice of 80% of voters is considered definitive, with 8% undecided, and a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: Quaest em RO: Marcos Rogério, 24%; Adailton Fúria, 21%; Expedito Netto, 10%; Hildon Chaves, 10%
item.description: Quaest poll of 804 Rondônia voters, commissioned by Rede Amazônica, shows Marcos Rogério (PL) at 24% and Adailton Fúria (PSD) at 21% in the statistical preference. The stimulated survey reveals 22% undecided voters, while the spontaneous survey leads with Adailton Fúria at 12%. 44% of voters consider a complete government change necessary, according to a survey registered with TSE.

item.title: Quaest na Paraíba: Lula, 50%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 21%; Ronaldo Caiado, 3%; Renan Santos; 2%; Romeu Zema, 1%
item.description: Quaest poll in Paraíba shows Lula leading with 50% in first-round voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 21%. The survey, conducted between August 21 and 24 with 804 voters, has a three-point margin of error and was commissioned by Cabo Branco and Paraíba TV stations.

item.title: Quaest em MT: Flávio Bolsonaro, 43%; Lula, 26%; Ronaldo Caiado, 4%; Renan Santos; 3%; Romeu Zema, 2%
item.description: Quaest survey in MT shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 43% against Lula's 26% in the scenario without Pablo Marçal. 78% of voters say they have already decided, with a margin of error of +/-3 points and 95% confidence.

item.title: Quaest: No 1º turno do DF, Lula tem 28% e Flávio Bolsonaro, 26%, e estão empatados tecnicamente
item.description: A Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Lula (28%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (26%) in the presidential race among voters in the Federal District. The three-percentage-point margin of error indicates the difference falls within the statistical range, resulting in a technical tie in the first round in the DF.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na sabatina de Romeu Zema a 'O Globo', 'Valor' e CBN
item.description: The Fato ou Fake fact-check column reviews statements made by Romeu Zema (Novo) during a roundtable interview with O Globo, Valor and CBN. His claim about Brazil's dependence on diesel and gasoline imports was labeled #FATO (true), supported by ANP data showing increased imports in 2025. However, his assertion that there were no scandals or fraud during his administration was debunked and tagged #FAKE, citing the Federal Police's Operation Rejeito, which uncovered a corruption scheme involving fraudulent environmental licenses for mining operations in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Economista da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe PEC fiscal e corte de 10 ministérios
item.description: Daniella Marques, economist advising Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential campaign, unveiled an economic agenda focused on overhauling Brazil's fiscal framework through a constitutional amendment during the transition period and creating a Superior Fiscal Governance Council. She also proposed cutting ten ministries and trimming commissioned positions, while criticizing the Judiciary and Congress as the most expensive per capita in the world.

item.title: PEC da Segurança: relator decide manter texto da Câmara para acelerar aprovação no Senado
item.description: The rapporteur of the Public Security Constitutional Amendment (PEC) in the Senate, Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE), announced he will keep the text approved by the Chamber of Deputies intact, with no changes, to speed up the process and allow direct promulgation. The proposal, President Lula's main bet for the area, toughens rules against organized crime and provides for asset seizure, but allies admit approval may be delayed until after the elections, with priority now given to ending the 6x1 work schedule.

item.title: Em Pernambuco Lula tem 54% no 1º turno e Flávio Bolsonaro, 19%, aponta Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll shows President Lula leading the presidential race in Pernambuco in the first round, with 54% of voting intentions. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is second with 19%, indicating a significant gap in favor of the PT incumbent in the state.

item.title: Clariana Barão diz ter valores da direita, mas rejeita extremismo
item.description: Clariana Barão, a presidential candidate for the Democracia Cristã party in Mato Grosso, stated she holds right-wing values but rejects the extremism she says has taken over that political field. She claimed the polarization between PT supporters and Bolsonaro allies is tiring voters, while acknowledging achievements from both administrations. Regarding Flávio Bolsonaro, she said she does not see in him the simplicity and humility she attributes to former president Jair Bolsonaro.
